Find quick answers about the formula, serving size, product benefits, ingredients, and private label service.
Creatine HCl Powder is a highly soluble form of creatine designed for convenient daily use. This pineapple-flavored formula provides 750mg of Creatine HCl in each 960mg serving.
How Many Servings Are Included in Each Bottle?
Each bottle contains 64 servings. The serving size is one scoop (960mg), and the total net weight is 2.2 OZ (61.4g).
What Are the Main Benefits of Creatine HCl?
Creatine HCl is formulated to support enhanced strength and power, increased muscle volume, improved high-intensity exercise performance, and faster post-workout recovery.
How Is Creatine HCl Different from Creatine Monohydrate?

Creatine HCl offers superior solubility, a high absorption rate, and a compact serving of less than 1g. It is designed to be gentle on the stomach and may suit consumers concerned about bloating associated with creatine monohydrate.
What Ingredients and Flavor Does This Product Contain?
The product has a naturally flavored pineapple profile. Each serving contains 750mg of Creatine HCl, with natural flavors and Stevia rebaudiana leaf extract as the other ingredients.
Is Private Label OEM and ODM Service Available?

Yes. Xinbada Industrial (Shenzhen) Group Co., Ltd. provides private label OEM and ODM service for sports nutrition brands. Packaging, branding, pricing, and minimum order requirements can be discussed based on the project.
